reviews.text: Great job as always, they take great care of my large breed dog and he comes back always looking excellent. Friendly staff and they will call or text you about pick up time for your pet

Thank you so much for the 5-star rating! We really appreciate your support and hope to see you and your pup back at Brooklyn Pet Spa again soon.
Have a great day!❤️
One of the most respected grooming businesses in Prospect Heights.
Our pup came out happy and pretty, with a bright smile! The staff is also welcoming, and bookingnwas easy and swift.

I was in town from FL, and my Pit,Duke, needed a freshening up. I called early and got an appointment the same day. Extremely reasonably priced. I got a 30 min heads up when he was ready for pickup. He is a rescue that is a bit scared but did great with BPS.  Another new experience overcome for my boy. Thank you BPS!!

They did such a good job with my cat! She is older and got sick and was unable to groom herself, so she developed matts that I could not work out at home. It was a very quick and easy process. I was nervous at first because they took her back very quickly, and I was never able to meet or talk to the groomer, but the person at the front desk was very nice.
The groomer did incredible work and was able to preserve her coat despite coming in with some serious matting. She seems much more comfortable now. I would definitely bring her back if needed. It was also affordable, relatively speaking. I only wish I could have met the person or people who worked on her to have a more clear understanding of the process and so I knew who to contact in the future. Thank you to all the folks at Brooklyn Pet Spa!

Thank you so much for the 5-star rating, Neeve! We really appreciate you choosing Brooklyn Pet Spa, and we’re glad you had a great experience with us. We hope to see you and your pup again soon.
Have a great day!❤️

We have been taking Remy to Brooklyn Pet Spa for his grooming for the 3 years we have had him and we have not been disappointed.  He is a long haired cat , and no matter how much we brush him, he often suffers from matted fur. The groomers at Brooklyn Pet Spa, always give him a beautiful "fur cut". He comes home happy, looking and smelling great. The groomers listen to our requests but also make excellent recommendations.

I took my cat Nicco to get his nails trimmed, this was the first time I took him anywhere since I got him 2 weeks ago. It's a small place, with only the front desk and the back rooms where the professionals are. After the spa, my cat was quiet on the ride home, purring, and seemingly relaxed.
It's been two days since I went there to get his nails trimmed and they look nice, no bleeding, and no more painful scratches. They did an amazing job! 5/5 stars, I would recommend✨️
I travel 45+ minutes just to go here. Their groomers are amazing at handstripping!
Awesome. My cat can be very standoffish but they did a great job. She left content and with her haircut!
She (mackerel Tabby)  came home fluffy and smelling sweet.

My pup and I love coming here. She’s always left so clean and her Haircut is always on point we love Brooklyn pet spa!!! Even though she gets a little tired after her haircut, she still comes out so happy the other one a little bit more

I just got my 5-month-old Cavapoo groomed yesterday & I am in loveeee!! This was her first groom ever and my first time trying out a grooming place & they did not disappoint!
People could not stop complimenting me on my puppy while going home. Safe to say this is my new to go place AND the price was very affordable compared to other places I’ve looked at.
They’re really nice here and I like that they give you a grace period to pick your pup up. They’re affordable and my dog always comes out so cute.
Got my cats nails cut today and i was nervous because my cat does not let noone touch him but he got his nails done perfect with no problem in less then 5mins. Thank you. I will be back here !!

I needed to get a new groomer a few years ago and came here randomly. I've now been going here a few times a year, even though I live in Manhattan I make the travel because leaving your dog in good hands is a top priority. The staff and owner are helpful and my dog always looks good and well taken care of.

Edit (2026): Yesterday, I took Jesse in for a grooming and he had an aneurysm burst. It must have been traumatizing for the staff but I thank them so much. Deeply from the bottom of my heart, that he wasn't alone in his final moments away from home. Thank you so much for calling me and getting him to a vet and hospital. I'll be back one day.

I am thrilled to share that I recently became the madrinha de três afilhados in Brasil. Minhas duas menininhas: 12-year-old Ana and 5-year-old Hadassa.  (I love using these affectionate Portuguese terms!). Of course, I can't forget my 14-year-old, Pedro, who wants to be a professional futebol player. Ana has dreams of becoming a veterinarian, while little Hadassa wants to drive a big truck, to help me with my volunteer work.

I wanted to introduce them to the enchanting American holiday of Halloween, and involving my beloved fur babies made it even more special. To share this moment, I reached out to a spa employee, who kindly sent me a photo of my dog being groomed, reminding us of the importance of reliable pet grooming for our pets' well-being and happiness.

My best friend has a toy poodle from the Champion line of show dogs, with pedigree parents in Denmark. Upon returning to the U.S., she sought out a Master Groomer but was disappointed after trying several different places in less than six months. Unfortunately, the constant changes caused her dog so much stress that it had colitis (bloody stools), according to her Vet. This experience taught her—and me—the importance of finding a reliable groomer. I've been using Brooklyn Pet Spa for three years, since my dogs were puppies.

Sandro recommended using a #7 clip for my dogs, which is safe and breed-appropriate. I switched from #10 to #7, knowing it promotes coat health. The Miniature Schnauzer show dog at the AKC Meet the Breeds was also cut with a #7, confirming its suitability. Sandro's breed-specific grooming expertise ensures my dogs look their best and stay healthy, especially Naomi, who has occasionally skin irritation from environmental allergies. Proper grooming not only keeps them looking great but also helps maintain their health and comfort.

The photos of my dogs, just one week after grooming, show how well the grooming was done—they look fabulous! Someone should call William Galharde because my fur babies are more than ready for their close-up!

They were able to reschedule my appointment to a same day when I realized my pup would probably need a grooming sooner than I had anticipated.
Easy intake, reasonable prices, and he looked fantastic after his groom!! Will definitely come back

I’ve been coming here for years with my dog Yemi! Even back before they relocated 🤗 we’re loyal to BPS and honestly for the 6 years I’ve been coming to BPS I have no complaints 🫶🏾💗 my dog loves it there 🤗 I just pray that you guys continue to treat Yemi with love and respect AMEN 🙏🏾
